pageDescription: How Solar Way collects, uses and protects personal data when you visit the website or send a request.
title: privacy policy
intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Solar Way collects, uses and protects personal data when you visit this website or send us a request. By using the website and submitting the contact form, you agree to the terms described below.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.text: Solar Way designs, installs and maintains solar stations for homes across Ukraine. We are responsible for the personal data you provide through this website. Our contact details are listed at the end of this policy.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
sections.text: When you fill out the contact form, we receive your name, your phone number and the service you are interested in. When you visit the website, standard technical data may also be recorded, such as your IP address, browser type, device type and the pages you view. We do not ask for payment details or other sensitive data on this website.

sections.title: 3. How we use your data
sections.text: We use your data to contact you about your request, prepare a cost calculation or consultation, provide and support our services, keep the website working correctly and meet our legal obligations. We do not use your phone number for advertising without your separate consent.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
sections.text: We process personal data on the basis of your consent, in order to take steps at your request before concluding a contract, and to comply with applicable law, including the Law of Ukraine “On Personal Data Protection”.

sections.title: 5. Who can access your data
sections.text: We do not sell your personal data. It is available only to Solar Way employees who handle your request and to service providers who help us run the website and deliver requests, such as hosting and messaging services. We may also disclose data when required by law.

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.text: The website may use cookies and similar technologies that are needed for it to work properly. You can restrict or delete cookies in your browser settings, although some parts of the website may then work differently.

sections.title: 7. How long we keep your data
sections.text: We keep personal data only for as long as it is needed for the purposes described in this policy or required by law. Requests that do not lead to a contract are deleted once they are no longer needed.

sections.title: 8. How we protect your data
sections.text: We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against loss, misuse and unauthorised access. However, no method of transmitting data over the internet is completely secure.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
sections.text: You have the right to know what data we hold about you, to access and correct it, to request its deletion, to object to its processing and to withdraw your consent at any time. You may also file a complaint with the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights. To exercise your rights, contact us using the details below.

sections.title: 10. Changes to this policy
sections.text: We may update this policy from time to time. The current version is always available on this page, with the date of the latest update shown at the top.
